station_name: Kings River below North Fork, near Trimmer, Calif.
notes: Duration estimate of daily specific conductance (7 values against percent of time exceeded), a statistical estimate from a regression, not measured values. Counted the 7 specific conductance values as measurements and the 7 percent-exceeded values only in n_variables; rules do not cover duration tables. Dates are the period in the table title (October 1959-September 1968), not measurement dates; no_time_series chosen. 'North Fork' in the station name is a stream, not a town. Other distances: 1.8 mi downstream from North Fork, 2.2 mi southwest of Balch Camp, 7.7 mi southeast of Trimmer. No basin named on page.
